يهتجر (form VIII)
# يَهْتَجِرُ (yahtajiru) /jah.ta.d͡ʒi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# يَهْتَجِرَ (yahtajira) /jah.ta.d͡ʒi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# يَهْتَجِرْ (yahtajir) /jah.ta.d͡ʒir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
